create_vqa_evaluator: create a VQAEvaluator instance to evaluate VQA model outputs against ground truth answers
reset_vqa_evaluator: reset the VQAEvaluator to clear accumulated results before starting a new evaluation run
process_vqa_batch: process a batch of VQA inputs and model outputs to accumulate predictions and ground truth answers
evaluate_vqa_metrics: evaluate VQA results and compute exact match, BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE, and CIDEr scores
evaluate_vqa_detection: evaluate VQA results with optional referential grounding detection metrics alongside language scores
